en.error.repository_required: Set the repository this provisioner serves.
en.error.not_repository: {repository} is not a git repository. Set the repository to a git checkout, or set a URL to clone from.
en.error.clone_target_busy: {repository} holds files but is not a git repository, so nothing was cloned there. Set the repository to an empty or missing directory.
en.error.clone_failed: Cloning {remote} into {repository} did not finish: {reason}. Check the URL and this worker's access to it, then try again.
en.error.unknown_base: There is no branch or commit named {base} in {repository}. Name one that exists.
en.error.empty_repository: {repository} has no commits yet. Commit something to it, then try again.
en.error.bad_branch: {branch} cannot be a git branch name. Name the workspace with letters, digits, dashes and slashes.
en.error.branch_elsewhere: The branch {branch} is checked out at {path}. Switch that checkout to another branch, then try again.
en.error.pool_overlap: The worktree directory {root} overlaps the repository {repository}. Set a worktree directory outside the repository.
en.error.phantom_slot: Git reported a new worktree at {directory}, but it is not there.
en.error.mount_failed: Preparing a worktree for {name} in {repository} did not finish: {reason}. Try again.
en.error.unmount_failed: Saving the uncommitted work in {path} did not finish: {reason}. The workspace stays mounted. Try again.
en.error.remove_failed: Removing the branch {branch} did not finish: {reason}. Try again.
en.error.check_failed: Neither the worktree {path} nor the repository {repository} can be read on this worker. Check that the disk is there.
en.error.provision_failed: Adding worktrees for {repository} did not finish: {reason}.
en.error.list_failed: Listing the worktrees of {repository} did not finish: {reason}.
en.error.teardown_failed: Removing the worktrees of {repository} did not finish: {reason}. Try again.
en.display.saved_work_kept: Kept in {ref}, because it did not apply cleanly
